mapper.sql: select feeding_id, baby_id, feed_time, feed_method, amount_ml, duration_min, left_duration, right_duration, burped, burp_duration, burp_effect, after_behavior, notes, operator_id, operator_name, rev, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_by_name, update_time, remark from nc_feeding
mapper.select: select to_char(feed_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as label, count(*)::int as count, coalesce(sum(amount_ml), 0) as amount from nc_feeding where baby_id = #{babyId} and del_flag = '0' and feed_time::date >= current_date - (#{days}::int - 1) group by to_char(feed_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') order by label
mapper.update: update nc_feeding set feed_time = #{feedTime}, feed_method = #{feedMethod}, amount_ml = #{amountMl}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, left_duration = #{leftDuration}, right_duration = #{rightDuration}, burped = #{burped}, burp_duration = #{burpDuration}, burp_effect = #{burpEffect}, after_behavior = #{afterBehavior}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_by_name = #{updateByName}, rev = rev + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where feeding_id = #{feedingId} and del_flag = '0' and rev = #{rev}
